brief: REPAIR.LOG happy-client figure for Bram Hollander (customers.ts: Copperline register hub, dominant lock, tiers 2-3), matching the three existing REPAIR.LOG figures' exact construction (ui-demos/kpos-shell/art/report-client-{sable,juno,aldous}.png / dive-report.html): a full-body, waist-up-or-taller figure celebrating with their fixed device, 1990s anime OVA ink style, flat cel shading, no text or speech bubbles or panel borders or lettering of any kind anywhere in the frame (this constraint has caused retakes before - hold to it strictly). Bram is a proud, weathered shopkeeper standing beside his register hub with the till drawer open, one hand resting on the counter like he has just proven a point to a machine that had it coming. Background a plain soft dark gradient only, no scene detail competing with the figure. NOTE: no appearance canon exists yet for this customer; this order waits on the loremaster's ruling on customer figure likenesses before art-lead spends any credits on it.
